title: Good Bacteria Club
intro: This quiz covers Maya's discovery that some bacteria help with digestion, protection, and balance in the body.

questions.prompt: What did Maya believe about bacteria at the beginning of the story?
questions.explanation: At the beginning, Maya believed all bacteria were dangerous.

questions.prompt: What did the words "live and active cultures" on the yogurt container mean?
choices: The yogurt could move by itself
The yogurt contained living helpful microbes
The yogurt was unsafe to eat
questions.explanation: "Live and active cultures" meant the yogurt contained living helpful microbes.

questions.prompt: How can helpful bacteria in the gut support the body?
choices: They help break down food and support balance
They pump blood through the body
They carry oxygen to the muscles
questions.explanation: Helpful bacteria in the gut help break down food and support balance.

questions.prompt: How can helpful bacteria make it harder for harmful germs to enter?
choices: They take up space that harmful germs might use
They turn into white blood cells
questions.explanation: Helpful bacteria take up space that harmful germs might use.

questions.prompt: Which foods did Maya's dad show her during their food investigation?
questions.explanation: Maya's dad showed her yogurt, kefir, and fermented pickles.
